answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake, joins a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree, and evaluates the epoch polynomial under a committed identity. RLN nullifiers enforce a message quota; duplicate use exposes Shamir-derived shares whose interpolation reveals the private key. A polynomial identity commitment verifies the conflict and triggers instantaneous collateral slashing. This prism of proofs makes the network a haven against Sybil floods, while the slash event supplies a public signal of misbehavior.
